scientific_limits.en: {"representation":"living-reconstruction","scope":"Whole robust low-bodied mammal with a large head and strong jaws, reconstructed mainly from IVPP V14155, with explicitly comparative hand/foot reconstruction from congeneric R.robustus.","scientific_limits":{"en":"V14155 preserves partial skull and articulated postcranium, but lacks manus and pes. Short broad plantigrade hands/feet are inferred using R.robustus V13605, not directly preserved in the modeled individual. Fur, ears, color and flesh are inferred. Tail364mm is preserved length, not certified complete tail. Mass12-14kg is regression estimate. Dinosaur stomach remains belong to R.robustus, not V14155.","zh":"V14155保存部分颅骨与关联骨架，但手足缺失。短宽跖行手足按同属R.robustus V13605比较推断，并非目标个体实证。毛、耳、颜色及软组织为复原；364毫米是保存尾长，非完整尾长保证。12至14千克为回归估计；恐龙胃内容物属于R.robustus，不属于V14155。"},"original_inventory_ordinal":661,"taxon":"Repenomamus giganticus","classification":"Eutriconodonta, Mammalia; extinct non-therian mammal, not a modern badger or rodent","scale":{"unit":"meter","published_skull_m":0.16,"published_trunk_m":0.522,"published_preserved_tail_m":0.364,"measurement_status":"Hu etal2005 IVPP V14155 measurements.","head_model_m":0.175,"trunk_model_m":0.522,"tail_model_m":0.39,"shoulder_model_m":0.23,"model_status":"Fleshed head/tail/shoulder are conservative original estimates; trunk follows published dimension. Overall about1.087m, not claimed exact living measurement."},"diagnostic_targets":["Low long robust torso with short stout semi-erect limbs, not long-legged running dog or extremely sprawling lizard.","Large elongate heavy head with thick mandible and broad rear cheek/temporal volume; no tiny shrew head or modern blunt pug face.","Strong neck continuous with substantial shoulders, distinguish jaw depth from body mass.","Short broad plantigrade feet inferred from congener; small separated toes/claws, no hooves or flippers.","Long tapering cylindrical tail, not Castorocauda paddle or a modern badger short stump.","Neutral inferred fur and small rounded ears; no modern badger mask, striped back or asserted fossil coat pattern."]}
